whenToUse: Project plans on a time axis with dependencies, progress and WBS numbers.
Editing task dates and predecessors inline.
avoidWhen: Simple to-do lists — use Task list.
Staff shifts or room bookings — use Resource calendar.
a11y: The task list is a WAI-ARIA treegrid; every bar edit is also possible in the grid.
Dependencies are listed as text (predecessors column).
